verdict.rationale: Appwrite's storage product page documents a built-in preview endpoint that can resize, crop, convert format, set quality, add borders, and rotate images from a single stored upload. That directly covers serving transformed images without running your own pipeline, and the storage docs back it with file APIs plus 'many added utilities'. missing for 10: in-depth reference docs for the preview endpoint (parameters, caching/CDN behavior, limits), independent or hands-on corroboration that transformations work as claimed
